label: Reading the counterexample
subgoals: Extract the failing cycle and the assertion's cone of influence
Classify the trace as base case, illegal environment or induction step
Check reachability of the start state before blaming the RTL

label: Proposing and checking a fix
subgoals: Re-run the target assertion and the whole property suite after each edit
Require the reference covers to stay reachable
Finish with an unbounded proof or report the bounded evidence honestly

label: Guardrails on the repair loop
subgoals: Reject edits that weaken, delete or bypass a property
Keep properties, covers and assumptions outside the agent's edit scope
Require human approval of RTL diffs after the proofs pass
